children: Boyd Group Services intends to launch a share-repurchase program to buy back up to 10% of its shares over the course of a one-year period.
The operator of nonfranchised collision-repair centers said Friday that the Toronto Stock Exchange has accepted its plan to buy back up to about 2.78 million shares for cancellation.
Shares have been significantly under pressure so far this year, with the stock down 48% since January to close on Thursday at 113.11 Canadian dollars ($81.77).
At Thursday's closing price, the value of the shares intended for buyback would be about C$314.4 million.
Boyd Group can begin buying back shares starting Sept. 16.
